metadata.title: Autodesk Inventor Frame Generator Operations — Structural Framing Skeleton (Inventor-only)
metadata.description: Parameter catalog for the Inventor Frame Generator environment — an Inventor-only assembly-level workspace with no Fusion 360 / hyperCAD-S equivalent. Frame Generator is skeleton-driven: a 3D wireframe (typically a single skeletal part with sketch lines) defines structural member centerlines, and Frame Members are placed by selecting skeleton edges and choosing a Content Center library family + size. End treatments (Mitre, Notch, Trim, Extend) are applied as separate features on the frame assembly. Catalog covers ~12 operations across member placement (Insert / Change / Reuse / Author), end treatments (Mitre, Notch, Trim, Extend, Trim-and-Extend, Lengthen/Shorten, Remove End Treatment), and frame output (Frame BOM). Bindings reference the FrameAssembly + FrameMember COM API (FrameMembers / MitreFrameMembers / NotchFrameMembers / TrimFrameMembers / ExtendFrameMembers / TrimExtendFrameMembers / LengthenShortenFrameMembers collections). Inventor Frame Generator is a writable + repairable workflow: changing a skeleton edge length or replacing an underlying family member triggers automatic regeneration of all dependent end treatments, so the catalog explicitly surfaces the parameters that control treatment persistence vs detach.
metadata.source: Autodesk Inventor 2025 Help — Frame Generator Reference; Inventor API Reference — Frame namespace (FrameComponentDefinition, FrameMember, FrameMemberDefinition, MitreFrameMembers, NotchFrameMembers, TrimFrameMembers, ExtendFrameMembers, TrimExtendFrameMembers, LengthenShortenFrameMembers, RemoveEndTreatments); Content Center Editor (Author Frame Member workflow); iLogic Frame Member iLogicVb cookbook

commonTabs.description: Standard parameter tabs across Inventor Frame Generator features. Insert Frame Member fans across Lines / Family / Orientation / Treatments tabs because of the breadth of options; treatment ops collapse to a single tab.

INSERT_FRAME_MEMBER.description: Place one or more frame members on selected skeleton edges. The frame member is sourced from a Content Center family (e.g., ANSI Square Tube, ISO Round Tube, AISC Wide-Flange) and oriented around its centerline using a 9-position alignment grid (TopLeft / Top / TopRight / Left / Center / Right / BottomLeft / Bottom / BottomRight) plus optional Custom1/Custom2 offsets and rotation. Each placement creates one part file per unique geometric instance plus an iAssembly grouping under the parent FrameAssemblyDocument. Inventor renames the member with a frame-group tag for downstream BOM filtering. End treatments can be pre-applied at insert time (Trim/Mitre/None per end) to shortcut the most common workflow.

parameters.name: Lines
parameters.description: Skeleton edges, sketch lines, or work-axes that define member centerlines (one frame member per selected line)

parameters.name: Frame Group
parameters.description: Tag name applied to all members placed in this insertion — used by Frame BOM filtering and renaming patterns

parameters.name: Standard
parameters.description: Content Center library standard

parameters.name: Family
parameters.description: Content Center family (e.g., 'ANSI Square Tube', 'ISO Round Tube', 'AISC Wide-Flange')

parameters.name: Family Member
parameters.description: Specific size designation within the family (e.g., '2 x 2 x 0.250' or 'W12x26')

parameters.name: Material Style
parameters.description: Override the family default material (e.g., 'Steel, Mild', 'Aluminum 6061')

parameters.name: Appearance Override
parameters.description: Render appearance override; defaults to material's appearance

parameters.name: Show Material in BOM
parameters.description: Surface the material designator in BOM rows

parameters.name: Alignment Position
parameters.description: 9-position grid alignment of the member cross-section relative to the skeleton line

parameters.name: Horizontal Offset
parameters.description: Custom-1 offset perpendicular to the skeleton line, in the cross-section's horizontal axis

parameters.name: Vertical Offset
parameters.description: Custom-2 offset perpendicular to the skeleton line, in the cross-section's vertical axis

parameters.name: Rotation Angle
parameters.description: Rotation of the cross-section about the skeleton line

parameters.name: Mirror
parameters.description: Mirror the cross-section across the skeleton line

parameters.name: Reference Endpoint
parameters.description: Which line endpoint anchors the member's local coordinate system

parameters.name: Custom Direction
parameters.description: Optional override of the member's longitudinal direction (when skeleton edge direction is ambiguous)

parameters.name: Flush Side
parameters.description: Auto-flush the member's cross-section to the skeleton line endpoint(s)

parameters.name: Start End Treatment
parameters.description: Pre-applied treatment at the start endpoint

parameters.name: End End Treatment
parameters.description: Pre-applied treatment at the end endpoint

parameters.name: Apply Default Mitre
parameters.description: When two newly inserted members share an endpoint, automatically mitre them

parameters.name: Naming Prefix
parameters.description: Prefix prepended to each generated part filename (e.g., 'M_'); appended with size + index

CHANGE.description: Replace an existing frame member with a different family / size / material while preserving the underlying skeleton edge and (optionally) end treatments. Reorient flag controls whether the new member adopts the prior orientation/offsets or resets to the family default.

parameters.name: Frame Member
parameters.description: Existing frame member to replace

parameters.name: New Standard
parameters.description: Target Content Center standard (defaults to current)

parameters.name: New Family
parameters.description: Target Content Center family

parameters.name: New Family Member
parameters.description: Target size designation within new family

parameters.name: Preserve End Treatments
parameters.description: Re-apply existing mitre/notch/trim/extend treatments to the replacement

parameters.name: Reorient
parameters.description: Reset orientation/offsets to family default rather than preserving

REUSE_FRAME_MEMBER.description: Place an additional instance of an existing frame member on new skeleton edges, sharing the same source part file (so changes to one instance ripple to all). Useful for repeated structural members in symmetric frames.

parameters.name: Source Member
parameters.description: Existing frame member to reuse as the geometric source

parameters.name: Target Lines
parameters.description: Skeleton edges to place reused instances on (one per edge)

parameters.name: Match Orientation
parameters.description: Copy alignment/offsets/rotation from source

parameters.name: Match Material Override
parameters.description: Copy material override from source

parameters.name: Naming Suffix
parameters.description: Suffix appended to reused-instance filenames (e.g., '_R')

MITRE.description: Mitre cut between two (single mitre) or three (double mitre) adjacent frame members sharing a vertex. Inventor uses British spelling 'Mitre' in API + UI. The mitre plane bisects the angle between members; gap parameter controls weld preparation. Three-member mitre handles tubular T-junctions and corner posts.

parameters.name: Mitre Type
parameters.description: Single mitre = 2-member joint; Double mitre = 3-member tubular T or corner

parameters.name: Member 1
parameters.description: First mitred member

parameters.name: Member 2
parameters.description: Second mitred member

parameters.name: Member 3
parameters.description: Third mitred member (Double mitre only)

parameters.name: Mitre Gap
parameters.description: Material gap left between mitred faces (for weld root opening)

parameters.name: Mitre Plane Override
parameters.description: Optional explicit mitre plane (defaults to bisecting plane of member centerlines)

parameters.name: Cope Both Members
parameters.description: Apply mitre to all selected members (default: only the longer member is coped)

NOTCH.description: Notch one or more frame members so they fit cleanly against another (typically larger) member. Profile Notch removes material along the notching member's profile boundary; Face Notch follows a planar face; Dual-Face Notch handles intersections with two faces (e.g., webs of an I-beam). Through-cut option fully removes the notched cross-section, useful for through-welds.

parameters.name: Notching Members
parameters.description: Member(s) to receive the notch (material removed)

parameters.name: Notched-To Member
parameters.description: Member providing the obstacle profile/face the notch conforms to

parameters.name: Notch Type
parameters.description: Profile = follows whole cross-section; Face = follows one planar face; Dual-Face = follows two webs/flanges

parameters.name: Notch Gap
parameters.description: Material gap between notched member and the obstacle

parameters.name: Axial Offset
parameters.description: Shift the notch along the notching member's axis

parameters.name: Through Cut
parameters.description: Cut entirely through the notching member (for through-welds rather than copes)

parameters.name: Notch Plane
parameters.description: Whether the notch plane is normal to the notching member or to the obstacle face

TRIM_TO_FRAME.description: Trim one frame member's end so it terminates flush against another frame member's face/edge. Distinct from Trim-To-Plane (which uses an arbitrary work-plane); Trim-to-Frame keeps the joint dependent on the target member, so moving the target re-trims automatically.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: Frame member to trim

parameters.name: Trim Side
parameters.description: Which end(s) of the member to trim

parameters.name: Trim Target
parameters.description: Frame member, face, edge, or work-plane the trim plane is derived from

parameters.name: Trim Offset
parameters.description: Offset the trim plane along the member's axis (signed)

EXTEND_TO_FRAME.description: Extend one frame member's end so it reaches a target frame member's face/edge. Mirror operation of Trim-To-Frame; both share the same Auto-Trim-Extend parent in the Inventor UI but are stored as separate features.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: Frame member to extend

parameters.name: Extend Side
parameters.description: Which end(s) of the member to extend

parameters.name: Extend Target
parameters.description: Frame member, face, edge, or work-plane the extension terminates at

parameters.name: Extend Offset
parameters.description: Offset past (or short of) the target plane along the member's axis (signed)

TRIM_AND_EXTEND.description: Combined Trim/Extend treatment that automatically picks Trim or Extend per-end based on whether the member overshoots or falls short of the target. Used when batch-processing multiple members at once or when the member configuration is changing.

parameters.name: Members
parameters.description: One or more frame members to trim/extend

parameters.name: Target
parameters.description: Frame member, face, edge, or work-plane the operation aligns to

parameters.name: Treatment Side
parameters.description: Auto picks the end closest to target

parameters.name: Offset
parameters.description: Signed offset past the target

parameters.name: Auto-Detect Direction
parameters.description: Inventor decides Trim vs Extend per-end (false forces uniform behavior)

LENGTHEN_SHORTEN.description: Adjust a frame member's length by an absolute delta (signed) at one or both ends, without referencing an external target. Used for fine-tuning fits after end-treatments are applied. Preserve End Treatment carries the existing miter/notch/trim/extend forward to the new length.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: Frame member to adjust

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: Which end(s) to adjust

parameters.name: Delta
parameters.description: Signed length change (+ lengthen, − shorten)

parameters.name: Preserve End Treatment
parameters.description: Re-apply existing mitre/notch/trim/extend at the new length

parameters.name: Reference Length Display
parameters.description: Which length basis the Delta is measured against

REMOVE_END_TREATMENT.description: Strip mitre/notch/trim/extend treatments from a frame member end, returning it to the raw skeleton-edge length. Useful when reworking a joint after upstream changes invalidate the prior treatment.

parameters.name: Member
parameters.description: Frame member whose end treatment is being removed

parameters.name: End
parameters.description: Which end's treatment to remove

parameters.name: Treatment Filter
parameters.description: Limit removal to one treatment family (default: all treatments at the chosen end)

FRAME_BOM.description: Emit a frame-specific Bill of Materials filtered to one or more Frame Group tags. Inventor's Frame BOM differs from the assembly BOM by adding cut-list grouping (group identical cross-section + length combinations), member-end-treatment summaries, and total cut length. Output supports CSV / XLSX / XML / parts-list table for drawing insertion.

parameters.name: Frame Group Filter
parameters.description: Frame group tag to include (blank = all groups)

parameters.name: Output Format
parameters.description: Emission format

parameters.name: Include Cut List
parameters.description: Group identical cross-section + length combinations into cut-list rows

parameters.name: Include Mass
parameters.description: Add per-row mass column

parameters.name: Include End Treatments
parameters.description: Surface mitre/notch/trim/extend treatments per member

parameters.name: Group By
parameters.description: Top-level grouping in the BOM output

parameters.name: Output Path
parameters.description: Filesystem path for emitted file (only meaningful for csv/xlsx/xml)

AUTHOR_FRAME_MEMBER.description: Author a custom Content Center frame member from a closed sketch profile. Creates a new family + family-member entry in the read-write Content Center library, callable via Insert Frame Member afterward. Used for non-standard structural shapes (proprietary extrusions, custom rolled sections). The authored profile's centroid becomes the alignment-grid Center; Inventor computes section-property metadata (area, second moment of area) automatically.

parameters.name: Profile Sketch
parameters.description: Closed 2D sketch profile (in a part file) defining the cross-section

parameters.name: Family Name
parameters.description: New Content Center family name

parameters.name: Member Type
parameters.description: Classification used by Frame BOM grouping

parameters.name: Default Material
parameters.description: Material assigned to new family-member instances

parameters.name: Size Designation
parameters.description: First family-member size identifier (e.g., '50 x 50 x 3')

parameters.name: Display Name
parameters.description: Human-readable name shown in Insert Frame Member dialog

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: Long-form description for the family member

parameters.name: Library
parameters.description: Target Content Center library for the new family

parameters.name: Compute Section Properties
parameters.description: Auto-compute area / second moment of area / radius of gyration from profile
